note: R660. The rules of the site adaptation manual, one row per rule of the block M01 to M15. A template is read only, a project takes a copy by rulesSetup. No row holds a value: the text of the manual is not in this repo, so no value could be checked against it, and a missing value is never guessed. manualRef says where a person looks.
